create_refund.rationale: Moves money back to a customer. Irreversible once settled.

send_stripe_mcp_feedback.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): submits free-text feedback about Stripe's MCP tooling to Stripe. Touches no account object, moves no money, reaches no customer.

stripe_api_details.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): describes the shape of a Stripe API operation.

stripe_api_read.rationale: Pass-through (read): every Stripe API GET. Authenticated and can return customer records, but the API key already reaches them and Stripe does not expose reusable secrets over GET — requiring authentication is not by itself a reason to govern.

stripe_api_search.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): finds the operation ID for a Stripe API call.

stripe_api_write.rationale: Every POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE on the Stripe API behind one tool name — charges, payouts, transfers, subscription and customer changes. Policy can still discriminate: the payload exposes /arguments/stripe_api_operation_id and /arguments/parameters, so requirements can differ by operation and by amount.

stripe_implementation_planner.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): generates integration guidance from Stripe documentation.
